IC1: 1. Women 18 to 40 years of age inclusive who can give written informed consent
IC2: 2. Available for all visits and consent to follow all procedures scheduled for the study
IC3: 3. Agree to daily application of gel and monitoring as per Daily Monitored Adherence (DMA) method
IC5: 5. HIV-negative [AND] as determined by a HIV rapid test at time of enrollment
IC6: 6. On a stable form of contraception and willing to continue on this stable method of contraception, OR, Have undergone surgical sterilisation at least 3 months prior to enrollment
IC7: 7. In the [NOT] absence of the use of exogenous hormone [AND](s), have a self-reported regular menstrual cycle defined as having a minimum of 21 days and a maximum of 36 days between menses
IC8: 8. Upon pelvic [OR]/speculum examination [OR] and colposcopy at the time of enrollment, the cervix and vagina appear normal as determined by the investigator
IC9: 9. Asymptomatic for genital infections at the time of enrollment
IC10: 10. Willing to [NOT] refrain from use of vaginal products [OR] or objects within 14 days prior to enrollment and for the duration of the study
IC11: 11. Willing to answer acceptability and adherence questionnaires throughout the study
IC12: 12. Willing to refrain from participation in any other research study for the duration of this study
IC13: 13. Willing to provide adequate locator information for study retention purposes and be reachable per local standard procedures
